questions.question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’ and

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

How is N related to R if N & P – Q + T × R?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 &
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Brother

 
 Wife
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

**Statement given :** N & P – Q + T × R

So,

 
• N & P → N is the wife of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2182f72e73be45e6fc4e22399b81109ab214faab6588a085cdeada17b366a86d.png] 

 
• P – Q → P is the father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a205dbbde2920a8b5c3001165e6e59aaa0afd6e923076acf3947789301d39e1a.png] 

 
• Q + T → Q is the mother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69642a049f0f61fa78c152c73d583edbc4db5585ea85926cc5591b89dddceb90.png] 

 
• T × R → T is the brother of R.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/792fa657ccf19b8a9c774dd187278c985e4593022fa9483d9984802cf7c1fc3a.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree N is the maternal grandmother i.e mother's mother of R.

Hence, "**Mother’s mother**" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters / number of consonants / vowels in the word)

Colour ∶ Green ∶∶ Figure ∶ ?
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Term : Category or type of the term

So,

 
• **Green** is a specific type or category of the general term **colour**.

Similarly,

 
• **Triangle** is a specific type or category of the general term **figure**.

Hence, **"Triangle"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

18 ∶ 3 ∶∶ 55 ∶ 4 ∶∶ 334 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
**Logic : **(1st number + 9) = Cube of 2nd number

So,

 
• 18 ∶ 3

18 + 9 = (3)³

27 = 27 (LHS = RHS)

And, 

 
• 55 ∶ 4

55 + 9 = (4)³

64 = 64 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly, 

 
• 334 ∶ ?

334 + 9 = (?)³

{sqrt{343} } = ?

**? = 7**

Hence, **"7"** is the correct answer.

**Statements:**

All pencils are erasers.

All pens are erasers.

All erasers are scales.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are scales.

II. All erasers are pencils.

III. Some erasers are pens.

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

All pens are scales → **Follow** (As, all pens are erasers and all erasers are scales. So, as whole pens comes in erasers which whole comes in scales, therefore it is definitely true.)

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters / number of consonants / vowels in the word.)

Success ∶ Failure ∶∶ Probably ∶ ?
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Term : Antonyms

__
 
• **Success** is antonym of **failure**.

Similarly,

 
• **Probably** is antonym of **definitely**.

Hence, **"****Definitely"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Urgently → It is antonym of minor, trivial, inessential etc.
 
• Definitely → It is antonym of questionably, probably, dubious etc.
 
• Perhaps → It is antonym of improbable, certainly, unlikely etc.
 
• Promptly → It is antonym of slowly, late, tardily etc.

questions.question: Six people P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting on a wall facing the South. Only Q is sitting between P and S. U is the immediate left of R. T is sitting to the right of S. Q is to the immediate right of P. Only U is between T and R. Who is sitting to the immediate right of S?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Six people P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting on a wall facing the South.

**Explanation : **

1) Only Q is sitting between P and S.

2) Q is to the immediate right of P.

As position of Q is not known yet therefore are four possible positions for Q.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dbf70545b24b27260130f0ab727502ab8bd4b6c9e693919d953222d6864cb22.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e383e89cc13d4ea297d3a6b3045c99d365fecb8171b7b81cc71be228047a982.png] 

 
• Case - (3) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d2ff4ab2b426b2f10f51df81a68df12f0fad9623c489fdcf4525db9b1b799f8.png] 

 
• Case - (4) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc5f3cea5686c655487eebef580796c7b3f7b2c6f6286618e821e24177efa198.png] 

3) Only U is between T and R.

4) U is the immediate left of R.

5) T is sitting to the right of S.

As in case - 1 there is no possible position for T therefore it is eliminated.

As in case - 2 there is no possible position for T and U according to the given condition therefore it is eliminated.

As in case - 3 there is no possible position for T, U and R according to the given condition therefore it is eliminated.

 
• Case - (4) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b7472bbdf92fa1aa21732336055e73b96f047b162d5fcf33a72cb27a5c21cfa.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement T is sitting to the immediate right of S.

Hence, **"T"** is the correct answer.
